headline.bm: Anthony Loke meletak jawatan Menteri Pengangkutan selepas Mahkamah Tinggi benarkan Najib jalani tahanan rumah, beberapa hari sebelum PRN Melaka 14 Nov, manakala Rubio berkata pertempuran besar terhadap Iran tidak perlu dan Hormuz kekal disekat. CPI AS yang panas menjadikan kenaikan kadar Fed Disember sepenuhnya dijangka, Anthropic melancarkan suite pejabat menjelang IPO, dan CISA menambah enam kelemahan dieksploitasi termasuk Barracuda dan Cisco BroadWorks.
headline.en: Anthony Loke quit as transport minister after the High Court let Najib serve house arrest, days before the Nov 14 Melaka poll, while Rubio says no major combat against Iran is needed and Hormuz stays blockaded. Hot US CPI pushed a December Fed hike to fully priced, Anthropic launched an office suite ahead of its IPO, and CISA added six exploited flaws including Barracuda and Cisco BroadWorks.

summary.bm: Trump berkata perang Iran akan tamat 'tidak lama lagi' dan mengurangkan kemungkinan serangan baharu, sambil menegaskan Israel dan sekutu Teluk mesti membayar balik kos perang. Tehran menafikan rundingan dirancang dan mendesak Washington memenuhi tuntutan Hormuz.
summary.en: Trump said the Iran war should end 'fairly soon' and played down new strikes, while also saying Israel and Gulf allies must repay the war's cost. Tehran denied planned talks and urged Washington to meet its Hormuz demands.

title.bm: Trump berkata Israel dan sekutu Teluk perlu membayar balik kos perang Iran
title.en: Trump says Israel and Gulf allies must repay the cost of the Iran war

why.bm: Tuntutan perkongsian kos dan sekatan Hormuz yang belum selesai mengekalkan ketidaktentuan harga minyak dan bahan api untuk Malaysia.
why.en: Cost-sharing demands and the unresolved Hormuz blockade keep oil and fuel prices uncertain for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Negara-negara GCC meluluskan komando tentera di Kuwait di tengah ketegangan AS-Israel-Iran, dan gabungan memintas peluru berpandu Houthi yang dilepaskan ke Riyadh. Gulf News turut melaporkan usaha seorang ahli Republikan untuk memakzulkan Setiausaha Pertahanan Hegseth.
summary.en: Gulf Cooperation Council states approved a military command in Kuwait amid US-Israel-Iran tensions, and a coalition intercepted Houthi missiles fired at Riyadh. Gulf News also reports a Republican move to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth.

title.bm: GCC meluluskan komando tentera di Kuwait ketika peluru berpandu Houthi ke Riyadh dipintas
title.en: GCC approves a military command in Kuwait as Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh are intercepted

why.bm: Penyelarasan ketenteraan Teluk yang lebih luas menandakan konflik mungkin berlarutan, satu risiko kepada bekalan minyak dan perkapalan.
why.en: Wider Gulf military coordination signals the conflict may stay long, a risk for oil supply and shipping.

summary.bm: Pengundian awal PRN Melaka ditutup hari ini selepas 12,531 anggota keselamatan dan pasangan mengundi di 31 pusat, dan berjalan lancar. Hari mengundi ialah 14 Nov bagi 28 kerusi dan 79 calon.
summary.en: Early voting for the Melaka election closed today after 12,531 security personnel and their spouses voted at 31 centres, and it ran smoothly. Polling day is Nov 14 for 28 seats and 79 candidates.

title.bm: Melaka mengundi 14 Nov: 28 kerusi, 79 calon; "Muafakat Melaka" BN-PN berdepan PH, Bersatu dan Bersama
title.en: Melaka votes Nov 14: 28 seats, 79 candidates; BN-PN "Muafakat Melaka" faces PH, Bersatu and Bersama

why.bm: Ujian penting bagi gabungan menjelang PRU16.
why.en: A key test for the coalitions ahead of GE16.

summary.bm: Menteri Dalam Negeri Saifuddin berkata pada 10 Nov mahkamah perlu menjelaskan sama ada Jabatan Penjara boleh melaksanakan tahanan rumah, kerana perintah Lembaga Pengampunan menyebutnya tetapi perintah pelepasan Mahkamah Tinggi berbunyi 'lepas serta-merta'. AGC menangguhkannya, Najib kekal ditahan, dan denda SRC RM50 juta dibayar Jumaat lalu. Peguam Negara berkata 'kesilapan ketara' dalam dokumen mahkamah menyebabkan kekeliruan. Polis turut dikerahkan di luar kediamannya di tengah khabar angin tahanan rumah.
summary.en: Home Minister Saifuddin said on Nov 10 the court must clarify whether the Prisons Department can carry out house arrest, since the Pardons Board order mentions it but the High Court's discharge order says "discharge forthwith". The AGC has deferred it, Najib stays in detention, and the RM50m SRC fine was paid last Friday. The Attorney-General said a "glaring error" in the court document caused confusion. Police were also deployed outside his residence amid house-arrest rumours.

title.bm: KDN tangguh tahanan rumah Najib kerana risiko "tahanan salah" sementara AGC mahu penjelasan perintah mahkamah
title.en: Home Ministry holds off Najib house arrest over "wrongful detention" risk while AGC seeks clarity on the court order

why.bm: Menekan gabungan kerajaan, Umno dan peranan istana enam hari sebelum PRN Melaka.
why.en: Puts the Madani coalition, Umno and the palace's role under strain six days before the Melaka polls.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan penjelasan Bank Negara pada 10 Nov. Berasingan, data DOSM menunjukkan indeks pengeluaran perindustrian naik 6.3% tahun ke tahun pada September.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports Bank Negara's explanation on Nov 10. Separately, DOSM data show the industrial production index rose 6.3% year on year in September.

title.bm: Bank Negara jelaskan mengapa rakyat masih rasa harga tinggi walaupun inflasi reda
title.en: Bank Negara explains why Malaysians still feel prices are high despite easing inflation

why.bm: Membantu menjelaskan tekanan kos sara hidup di sebalik sentimen rakyat menjelang PRN Melaka.
why.en: Helps explain the cost-of-living pressure behind public sentiment before the Melaka polls.

summary.bm: Kadir Jasin berkata kerajaan wajib menyiasat sumber wang RM50 juta itu. Umno membayar denda pada 6 Nov, langkah yang membolehkan Najib menjalani baki hukuman SRC di rumah.
summary.en: Commentator Kadir Jasin says the government has a moral duty to audit where the RM50m came from. Umno paid the fine on 6 Nov, a step that would let Najib serve the rest of his SRC sentence at home.

title.bm: Desakan siasat sumber dana RM50 juta Umno bagi denda Najib bertambah
title.en: Calls grow to probe the source of Umno's RM50m payment for Najib's fine

why.bm: Menambah pemerhatian terhadap dana parti beberapa hari sebelum PRN Melaka.
why.en: Adds scrutiny of party funding days before the Melaka polls.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan angka itu pada 9 Nov; Sinar Harian melaporkan NACSA berkata malware XCPE ditanam dalam peranti semasa pembuatan dan sukar dikesan pengguna biasa.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports the figure on Nov 9; Sinar Harian reports NACSA saying XCPE malware is planted in devices at manufacture and is hard for ordinary users to detect.

title.bm: Nacsa rekod 5,110 insiden siber dari Januari hingga September
title.en: Nacsa records 5,110 cyber incidents from January to September

why.bm: Gunakan peranti berjenama dipercayai dan kemas kini perisian tegar.
why.en: Use reputable devices and keep firmware updated.

summary.bm: MKN menyatakan keadaan keselamatan siber negara terkawal dengan tahap ancaman sederhana, manakala NACSA mencatat insiden melibatkan beberapa institusi kewangan. Fahmi berkata cubaan itu tidak menyebabkan kecurian data atau gangguan perbankan, dan Kabinet meminta semakan lebih mendalam ke atas aset kerajaan, bank dan GLC. Menteri Pertanian Mohamad Sabu berkata tiada arahan menyimpan stok makanan dan menggesa orang ramai bertenang.
summary.en: MKN says the national cybersecurity situation is under control with the threat level at moderate, while NACSA has noted incidents involving several financial institutions. Fahmi says the attempts caused no data theft or banking disruption, and Cabinet asked for a deeper review of government assets, banks and GLCs. Agriculture Minister Mohamad Sabu said there is no food-stockpile directive and urged calm.

title.bm: Kerajaan: perbankan dalam talian selamat selepas cubaan serangan siber; Anwar arah semakan menyeluruh
title.en: Govt says online banking is safe after attempted cyberattacks; Anwar orders a full cybersecurity review

why.bm: Pengguna disaran bergantung pada saluran rasmi dan bank masing-masing, bukan dakwaan media sosial.
why.en: Ordinary users should rely on official channels and their banks, not social media claims.

summary.bm: Bank Negara mengekalkan Kadar Dasar Semalaman (OPR) pada 2.75% pada 5 Nov, seperti dijangka kebanyakan ekonomi, pada mesyuarat MPC keenam dan terakhir 2026. Segelintir ekonomi sebelum ini menjangka kenaikan 25 mata asas kepada 3%.
summary.en: Bank Negara left the Overnight Policy Rate unchanged at 2.75% on Nov 5, as most economists had expected, ending the year's sixth and final MPC meeting. A minority had called for a 25bp hike to 3%.

title.bm: Bank Negara kekalkan OPR pada 2.75% pada mesyuarat MPC terakhir 2026
title.en: Bank Negara holds OPR at 2.75% at its final 2026 MPC meeting

why.bm: Ansuran pinjaman dan pinjaman perumahan yang dikaitkan dengan OPR tidak berubah buat masa ini.
why.en: Loan and mortgage instalments tied to the OPR stay unchanged for now.

summary.bm: Dewan bersidang 37 hari hingga 8 Dis, dan agenda hari ini merangkumi analisis sampel RON95 dari lima negeri serta kesiapsiagaan jerebu kerana El Nino dijangka berlarutan hingga pertengahan 2027.
summary.en: The house sits 37 days until Dec 8, and today's agenda covers RON95 sample analysis from five states and haze preparedness as El Nino is expected to last to mid-2027.

title.bm: Dewan Rakyat: peringkat jawatankuasa Belanjawan 2027 hingga 26 Nov; kualiti RON95 dan jerebu dibangkitkan
title.en: Dewan Rakyat: Budget 2027 committee stage runs to Nov 26 as RON95 quality and haze come up

why.bm: Menunjukkan isu yang dibahas Parlimen sebelum belanjawan diluluskan.
why.en: Shows what Parliament will tackle before the budget passes.

summary.bm: Lapan orang dihanyutkan berhampiran Kuala Kubu Bharu kira-kira 5.55 petang 9 Nov; lima mayat ditemui dan operasi mencari di empat sektor diteruskan. Mangsa termasuk seorang rakyat Malaysia dan warga asing.
summary.en: Eight people were swept away near Kuala Kubu Bharu at about 5.55pm on Nov 9; five bodies have been found and a search in four sectors continues. Victims include one Malaysian and foreigners.

title.bm: Air bah Sungai Pertak: lima mayat ditemui, tiga masih hilang di Hulu Selangor
title.en: Pertak river surge: five bodies found, three still missing in Hulu Selangor

why.bm: Jauhi sungai dan kawasan rekreasi ketika hujan lebat.
why.en: Stay away from rivers and recreation areas during heavy rain.

summary.bm: Mangsa dipindahkan di Selangor meningkat kepada 583 pada 9 Nov manakala angka di Perak menurun sedikit, dan Pantai Timur bersiap sedia menghadapi hujan lanjut. Anwar mengumumkan bantuan tunai RM2,500 untuk mangsa banjir Selangor yang layak.
summary.en: Selangor evacuees rose to 583 on Nov 9 while Perak numbers eased slightly, and the East Coast is bracing for more rain. Anwar announced RM2,500 cash aid for eligible Selangor flood victims.

title.bm: Mangsa banjir Selangor meningkat lebih dua kali ganda kepada 583 ketika Perak reda; Anwar umum bantuan tunai RM2,500
title.en: Selangor flood evacuees more than double to 583 as Perak eases; Anwar announces RM2,500 aid

why.bm: Elak jalan banjir dan ikuti maklumat agensi bencana negeri.
why.en: Avoid flooded roads and follow state disaster updates.

summary.bm: Bantuan tunai RM2,500 diberikan kepada mangsa banjir Selangor yang layak; Kosmo menyatakan bayaran bermula 10 Nov.
summary.en: Cash aid of RM2,500 goes to eligible Selangor flood victims, with Kosmo saying payments start Nov 10.

title.bm: Anwar umum bantuan banjir RM2,500 setiap isi rumah layak di Selangor
title.en: Anwar announces RM2,500 flood aid per eligible Selangor household

why.bm: Isi rumah terjejas patut semak kelayakan dengan pihak berkuasa tempatan.
why.en: Affected households should check eligibility with local authorities.

summary.bm: Kosmo melaporkan sembilan jajahan diramal banjir; MetMalaysia memberi amaran hujan berterusan di Kelantan, Terengganu, Pahang dan Sabah hingga Rabu.
summary.en: Kosmo reports nine districts forecast to flood; MetMalaysia warns of continuous heavy rain in Kelantan, Terengganu, Pahang and Sabah until Wednesday.

title.bm: Sembilan jajahan Kelantan diramal banjir hingga Rabu
title.en: Nine Kelantan districts forecast to flood until Wednesday

why.bm: Patuhi notis pemindahan dan elak jalan banjir.
why.en: Follow evacuation notices and avoid flooded roads.

summary.bm: Sinar Harian melaporkan mangsa dipanah petir ialah dua beradik dan sepupu mereka yang sering menghabiskan masa bersama. Butiran kejadian masih dikemas kini.
summary.en: Sinar Harian reports the lightning victims were two siblings and their cousin who often spent time together. Details of the incident were still emerging.

title.bm: Tragedi dipanah petir: mangsa dua beradik dan sepupu
title.en: Lightning strike tragedy: victims were two siblings and a cousin

why.bm: Berlindung di dalam bangunan ketika ribut petir dan elakkan kawasan lapang serta air.
why.en: Seek shelter indoors during thunderstorms and avoid open fields and water.

summary.bm: QuickCheck The Star menilai dakwaan itu palsu. Mohamad Sabu berkata kerajaan belum sampai ke tahap itu dan menasihati orang ramai tidak membeli panik, dengan stok beras cukup enam bulan dan bekalan ikan beku terjamin lapan bulan; Fomca sebelum ini menyarankan pengguna menyimpan bekalan 72 jam sebagai langkah berjaga-jaga.
summary.en: The Star's QuickCheck rates the claim false. Mohamad Sabu said the government has not reached that stage and advised against panic buying, saying rice stocks last six months and frozen fish supply is assured for eight months; Fomca had advised consumers to keep 72 hours of supplies as a precaution.

title.bm: QuickCheck: tiada arahan kerajaan simpan stok makanan tiga hari
title.en: QuickCheck: no government order to stockpile three days of food

why.bm: Elak membeli panik dan semak dakwaan dengan sumber rasmi.
why.en: Avoid panic buying and check claims against official sources.

summary.bm: Kemalangan berhampiran Kelab Golf Permas Jaya dilaporkan jam 4.35 pagi; kereta terbakar kira-kira 90%, tiga daripada lima penumpang terselamat dan dua dihantar ke hospital.
summary.en: The crash near Permas Jaya Golf Club was reported at 4.35am; the car was about 90% burnt, three of five occupants escaped and two were hospitalised.

title.bm: Dua rentung selepas Mercedes terbakar akibat kemalangan di Johor Bahru
title.en: Two burnt to death as Mercedes catches fire after crash in Johor Bahru

why.bm: Peringatan untuk memandu berhati-hati pada awal pagi.
why.en: A reminder to drive carefully on early-morning roads.

summary.bm: Kementerian mengerahkan 387 pegawai dalam 85 pasukan bagi respons banjir monsun.
summary.en: The ministry has deployed 387 personnel in 85 teams for monsoon flood response.

title.bm: KKM kerah 387 pegawai dalam 85 pasukan untuk banjir monsun
title.en: Health Ministry deploys 387 personnel in 85 teams for monsoon floods

why.bm: Awasi leptospirosis dan penyakit bawaan air selepas banjir.
why.en: Watch for leptospirosis and water-borne illness after floods.

summary.bm: Amaran tahap waspada meliputi sebahagian Kelantan, Pahang dan Sabah serta seluruh Terengganu hingga 11 Nov, dengan Kudat dan Sandakan terjejas dari 9 Nov. Monsun timur laut berlarutan hingga Mac.
summary.en: An alert-level warning covers parts of Kelantan, Pahang and Sabah plus all of Terengganu until Nov 11, with Kudat and Sandakan affected from Nov 9. The north-east monsoon lasts until March.

title.bm: MetMalaysia: amaran hujan berterusan di empat negeri hingga Rabu
title.en: MetMalaysia: continuous rain alert for four states until Wednesday

why.bm: Rancang perjalanan dan pantau amaran banjir di pantai timur.
why.en: Plan trips and watch flood alerts on the east coast.

summary.bm: Laluan Rel Pantai Timur memulakan percubaan akhir menjelang pelancaran perkhidmatan penumpang 12 Dis.
summary.en: The East Coast Rail Link begins its final trial run ahead of the Dec 12 passenger service launch.

title.bm: ECRL masuk percubaan akhir sebelum perkhidmatan penumpang 12 Dis
title.en: ECRL enters final trial run before Dec 12 passenger launch

why.bm: Rancang perjalanan Pantai Timur untuk Disember.
why.en: Plan East Coast travel for December.

summary.bm: Tiga rakyat Malaysia ditahan di lapangan terbang Mauritius selepas rampasan 76.14kg ganja.
summary.en: Three Malaysians were detained at an airport in Mauritius after a 76.14kg cannabis seizure.

title.bm: Tiga rakyat Malaysia ditahan di Mauritius selepas rampasan dadah 76kg
title.en: Three Malaysians arrested in Mauritius over 76kg drug seizure

why.bm: Jangan bawa bungkusan orang tidak dikenali semasa bepergian.
why.en: Never carry parcels for strangers when travelling.

summary.bm: Sinar Harian melaporkan Malaysia di tangga ke-19 aktiviti ancaman yang dikesan ketika agensi berwaspada siber.
summary.en: Sinar Harian reports Malaysia ranks 19th for detected threat activity, as agencies stay on cyber alert.

title.bm: Malaysia di tangga ke-19 ancaman siber global pada peta langsung Kaspersky
title.en: Malaysia ranks 19th for global cyber-threat activity on Kaspersky's live map

why.bm: Gunakan kata laluan kukuh dan MFA serta elak pautan mencurigakan.
why.en: Use strong passwords and MFA and avoid suspicious links.

summary.bm: Serbuan sekitar 12.30 pagi menahan 195 pengunjung bawah umur: 93 lelaki tempatan, 61 wanita tempatan, 16 lelaki asing dan 25 wanita asing. Polis meneruskan siasatan.
summary.en: The raid around 12.30am detained 195 underage patrons: 93 local males, 61 local females, 16 foreign males and 25 foreign females. Police are continuing investigations.

title.bm: Polis serbu premis hiburan tanpa lesen di KL, tahan 195 remaja bawah umur
title.en: Police raid unlicensed KL entertainment outlet, detain 195 underage patrons

why.bm: Menimbulkan kebimbangan tentang penguatkuasaan had umur di premis hiburan.
why.en: Raises concern over enforcement of age limits at entertainment venues.

summary.bm: Kosmo melaporkan enam pemain Selangor FC tidak akan menyertai skuad kebangsaan.
summary.en: Kosmo reports six Selangor FC players will not join the national squad.

title.bm: Enam pemain Selangor FC tidak sertai skuad Harimau Malaya
title.en: Six Selangor FC players not joining the Harimau Malaya squad

why.bm: Menjejaskan persiapan pasukan kebangsaan.
why.en: Affects national team preparations.

summary.bm: The Star melaporkan limpahan trafik Deepavali di Lebuhraya Utara-Selatan pada 7 Nov. Jalan Batu Arang-Ijok juga ditutup dua hala selepas tanah runtuh.
summary.en: The Star reported a heavy Deepavali exodus on the North-South Expressway on Nov 7. Roads such as Jalan Batu Arang-Ijok were also closed both ways after a landslide.

title.bm: Kesesakan balik kampung Deepavali di Lebuhraya Utara-Selatan
title.en: Deepavali balik kampung rush builds on the North-South Expressway

why.bm: Semak keadaan trafik sebelum bertolak.
why.en: Check traffic updates before leaving.

summary.bm: Sembilan suspek berumur 16 hingga 42 tahun direman hingga 15 Nov atas kematian lelaki 19 tahun yang ditikam pada 7 Nov. Bedah siasat mendapati kecederaan di dada dan kes disiasat sebagai bunuh.
summary.en: Nine suspects aged 16 to 42 were remanded until Nov 15 over the death of a 19-year-old stabbed on Nov 7. The post-mortem found chest injuries and the case is probed as murder.

title.bm: Sembilan direman kes pergaduhan maut di Sibu
title.en: Nine remanded over fatal Sibu brawl

why.bm: Menunjukkan tindakan polis terhadap keganasan belia.
why.en: Shows police action on youth violence.

summary.bm: Seorang pesara kerugian RM179,490 selepas penipu menyamar polis mendakwa beliau terlibat pengubahan wang haram. Polis menggesa orang ramai mengesahkan panggilan sebegini.
summary.en: A retiree lost RM179,490 after scammers posing as police claimed he was linked to money laundering. Police urge the public to verify such calls.

title.bm: Penipu menyamar polis tipu pesara RM179,490 dalam sindiket pengubahan wang haram
title.en: Fake cops cheat retiree of RM179,490 in money-laundering scam

why.bm: Penipuan menyamar pihak berkuasa masih kerap berlaku; jangan pindahkan wang atas arahan panggilan telefon.
why.en: Impersonation scams remain a top fraud type; never transfer money on a phone call's demand.

summary.bm: Serbuan di Kampung Kubang Panjang merampas 49 guni (1,216 kg) dan sebuah van, bernilai keseluruhan RM22,864, dan seorang pemandu 35 tahun ditahan.
summary.en: The raid at Kampung Kubang Panjang netted 49 sacks (1,216 kg) and a van, worth RM22,864 in total, and a 35-year-old driver was detained.

title.bm: GOF rampas 1.2 tan beras disyaki seludup dari Thailand di Tumpat
title.en: GOF seizes 1.2 tonnes of suspected Thai smuggled rice in Tumpat

why.bm: Menunjukkan penguatkuasaan berterusan terhadap penyeludupan beras.
why.en: Shows continued enforcement against rice smuggling.

summary.bm: Kakitangan dilihat memakai payung di dalam bangunan pada malam 7 Nov. Jabatan Kesihatan Pulau Pinang berkata tiada pesakit terjejas dan unit penyelenggaraan bertindak segera.
summary.en: Staff were seen using umbrellas indoors on the night of Nov 7. Penang Health says no patients were affected and maintenance acted immediately.

title.bm: Tular: siling bocor di Hospital Seberang Jaya ketika hujan lebat
title.en: Viral: ceilings leak at Seberang Jaya Hospital in heavy rain

why.bm: Menimbulkan persoalan tentang bangunan hospital lama ketika monsun.
why.en: Raises questions on ageing hospital buildings in the monsoon.

summary.bm: Dalam satu daripada tiga pertikaian, tribunal mengawardkan RM2,000 dengan faedah 8% dan mendapati Auto Accept serta Fast Cancel melanggar Akta Pekerja Gig 2025. Dalam kes lain, penyahaktifan seorang pemandu atas salah laku disahkan.
summary.en: In one of three disputes the tribunal awarded RM2,000 with 8% interest and found Auto Accept and Fast Cancel breached the Gig Workers Act 2025. In another it upheld a driver's deactivation over misconduct.

title.bm: Tribunal Pekerja Gig putuskan auto-accept GrabCar langgar hak pemandu
title.en: Gig Workers Tribunal rules GrabCar's auto-accept breaches drivers' rights

why.bm: Ujian awal undang-undang pekerja gig baharu bagi pemandu e-hailing.
why.en: An early test of the new gig-worker law for e-hailing drivers.

summary.bm: Menteri Besar berkata DUN tidak akan dibubarkan dan persidangan Bajet diteruskan. Ia susulan kemelut istana yang masih berlarutan.
summary.en: The Menteri Besar says the state assembly will not be dissolved and the Budget sitting will proceed. This comes amid the ongoing royal row.

title.bm: MB Negeri Sembilan: tiada pembubaran DUN, persidangan Bajet diteruskan
title.en: Negeri Sembilan MB: no dissolution of state assembly, Budget sitting to go ahead

why.bm: Menandakan kestabilan politik buat masa ini di negeri itu.
why.en: Signals political stability for now in the state.

summary.bm: Chow Kon Yeow berkata Suruhanjaya Siasatan Negeri akan diputuskan selepas DOSH menyiapkan siasatan tanah runtuh 25 Okt yang meragut seorang lelaki. Kawasan itu belum diisytiharkan selamat dan kepulangan penduduk belum diputuskan.
summary.en: Chow Kon Yeow said a State Commission of Inquiry will be decided only after DOSH finishes its probe of the Oct 25 landslide that killed one man. The area has not been declared safe and residents' return is undecided.

title.bm: Pulau Pinang putuskan siasatan selepas siasatan DOSH tanah runtuh Paya Terubong
title.en: Penang to decide on inquiry after Paya Terubong landslide probe

why.bm: Keselamatan pembangunan lereng bukit terus diberi perhatian.
why.en: Hillside-development safety stays in focus.

summary.bm: Sebuah kereta tergelincir dan terhempas di lebuh raya PLUS berhampiran Tanjong Malim, meragut dua adik-beradik tiri. Hujan lebat menjadikan lebuh raya licin.
summary.en: A car skidded and crashed on the PLUS highway near Tanjong Malim, killing two step-sisters. Heavy rain has made highways slippery.

title.bm: Dua adik-beradik tiri maut kemalangan di PLUS berhampiran Tanjong Malim
title.en: Two step-sisters killed in PLUS crash near Tanjong Malim

why.bm: Pandu perlahan dan jaga jarak ketika hujan.
why.en: Drive slowly and keep distance in the rain.

summary.bm: Menteri Dalam Negeri menggesa perkongsian data antara agensi, dan The Star melaporkan pendekatan pelbagai kementerian diperlukan bagi keselamatan sekolah.
summary.en: The Home Minister called for data sharing among agencies, and The Star reported a multi-ministerial approach is needed on school security.

title.bm: Saifuddin mahu sekolah, polis dan agensi kesihatan kongsi data pelajar berisiko
title.en: Saifuddin wants schools, police and health agencies to share data on at-risk students

why.bm: Menyasarkan bantuan awal untuk pelajar berisiko.
why.en: Targets early help for students at risk.

summary.bm: FMT melaporkan lebihan dagangan China melonjak melepasi AS$1 trilion, didorong eksport berkaitan AI.
summary.en: FMT reports China's trade surplus surged past US$1tn, powered by AI-related exports.

title.bm: Lebihan dagangan China melepasi AS$1 trilion apabila ledakan AI menaikkan eksport
title.en: China's trade surplus passes US$1 trillion as AI boom lifts exports

why.bm: Meningkatkan risiko ketegangan dagangan menjelang sidang APEC dan memberi kesan kepada eksport elektronik Malaysia.
why.en: Raises trade-tension risk ahead of the APEC summit and affects Malaysia's electronics exports.

summary.bm: CPI AS Oktober naik 0.4% bulan ke bulan berbanding jangkaan 0.3%, dengan CPI teras naik 0.3% berbanding ramalan 0.2%. Gabenor Fed Waller menyokong sekurang-kurangnya kenaikan suku mata peratusan pada Disember, dan S&P 500 didagangkan kira-kira 0.9% lebih rendah serta Nasdaq sekitar 1% lebih rendah pada Selasa.
summary.en: US October CPI rose 0.4% month on month against 0.3% expected, with core CPI up 0.3% versus 0.2% forecast. Fed Governor Waller backs at least a quarter-point hike in December, and the S&P 500 traded about 0.9% lower and the Nasdaq about 1% lower on Tuesday.

title.bm: Data inflasi AS yang panas meningkatkan jangkaan kenaikan kadar Fed dan menekan Wall Street
title.en: Hot US inflation data lifts Fed rate-hike bets and hits Wall Street

why.bm: Kadar AS lebih tinggi lebih lama boleh menekan ringgit, Bursa dan kos import Malaysia.
why.en: Higher-for-longer US rates can pressure the ringgit, Bursa and Malaysian import costs.

summary.bm: Reuters: Brent turun 1.5% kepada $96.91 dan WTI 1% kepada $89.85 pada 9 Nov selepas Trump mengisyaratkan sikap berhati-hati terhadap Iran, walaupun kedua-dua pihak melaporkan kapal diserang berhampiran Hormuz. Brent jatuh 16% minggu sebelumnya, penurunan mingguan paling tajam sejak awal Covid; penganalisis menyebut sokongan sekitar $93 dan lebihan bekalan (JPMorgan: 1.4 juta tong sehari bagi Oktober).
summary.en: Reuters: Brent fell 1.5% to $96.91 and WTI 1% to $89.85 on Nov 9 after Trump signalled restraint on Iran, even as both sides reported shipping hit near Hormuz. Brent fell 16% the previous week, its steepest weekly drop since the start of Covid; analysts cite support near $93 and a supply surplus (JPMorgan: 1.4m bpd in October).

title.bm: Brent tutup minggu hampir $98 selepas penurunan mingguan terbesar sejak 2020, tetapi serangan Hormuz kekalkan turun naik
title.en: Brent ends the week near $98 after its biggest weekly fall since 2020, but Hormuz attacks keep it volatile

why.bm: Minyak mempengaruhi kos subsidi bahan api dan inflasi di Malaysia.
why.en: Oil drives fuel subsidy costs and inflation in Malaysia.

summary.bm: Selepas menguasai Kongres, Demokrat dilaporkan menyediakan siasatan pengawasan terhadap Elon Musk, penasihat Rumah Putih Stephen Miller dan syarikat-syarikat, menurut laporan Rappler. Butiran masa dan skop belum disahkan.
summary.en: After taking Congress, Democrats are preparing oversight probes of Elon Musk, White House adviser Stephen Miller and corporations, according to Rappler's report. Details of timing and scope have not been confirmed.

title.bm: Demokrat rancang siasatan terhadap Musk, Miller dan syarikat besar selepas kemenangan pilihan raya separuh penggal
title.en: Democrats plan investigations of Musk, Miller and big business after midterm win

why.bm: Petanda Washington lebih mencabar untuk dasar Trump dan hubungan teknologi/perniagaan AS.
why.en: Signals a harder Washington for Trump policy and US tech/business ties.

summary.bm: Al Jazeera melaporkan sekurang-kurangnya 16 orang terbunuh dalam letupan di sebuah kilang keluli di Turkiye.
summary.en: Al Jazeera reports at least 16 people were killed in an explosion at a steel plant in Turkey.

title.bm: Letupan di kilang keluli Turkiye bunuh sekurang-kurangnya 16 orang
title.en: Explosion at Turkish steel plant kills at least 16

why.bm: Bencana industri besar; punca dan angka korban mungkin dikemas kini.
why.en: A major industrial disaster; cause and toll may be updated.

summary.bm: Pegawai kanan AS dan China membangkitkan kebimbangan perdagangan dan AS meminta Beijing mematuhi komitmen perjanjian dagang Busan. APEC diadakan di Shenzhen dan gencatan perdagangan menghadapi tarikh akhir Januari.
summary.en: Senior US and Chinese officials raised trade concerns and the US asked Beijing to uphold its Busan trade-deal commitments. APEC is in Shenzhen and the trade truce faces a January deadline.

title.bm: AS dan China bertukar kebimbangan perdagangan menjelang sidang kemuncak APEC
title.en: US and China swap trade concerns as APEC summit nears

why.bm: Nada hubungan AS-China menentukan arah pengeksport ASEAN.
why.en: US-China tone sets the direction for ASEAN exporters.

summary.bm: Seorang lelaki Poland berusia 24 tahun membunuh enam orang dan mencederakan kira-kira 15 lain pada 7 Nov sebelum ditembak polis; tiga ahli keluarganya ditemui mati di rumah. PM Tusk menyifatkannya keganasan dan Poland mengadakan dua hari berkabung bermula 8 Nov, manakala Anwar mengecam serangan itu.
summary.en: A 24-year-old Polish gunman killed six and wounded about 15 on Nov 7 before police shot him; three relatives were found dead at the family home. PM Tusk called it terrorism and Poland began two days of mourning on Nov 8, while Anwar condemned the attack.

title.bm: Lelaki berfahaman ekstrem kanan bunuh enam orang di Dataran Utama Krakow
title.en: Gunman with far-right views kills six in Krakow's Main Square

why.bm: Menimbulkan kebimbangan terhadap keganasan ekstrem kanan di Eropah.
why.en: Raises concern over far-right violence in Europe.

summary.bm: Klaas Knot dan Pablo Hernandez de Cos dinamakan sebagai calon untuk mengetuai Bank Pusat Eropah.
summary.en: Klaas Knot and Pablo Hernandez de Cos have been named as candidates to lead the European Central Bank.

title.bm: Calon Belanda dan Sepanyol bersaing menggantikan Lagarde di ECB
title.en: Dutch and Spanish candidates to vie to succeed ECB's Lagarde

why.bm: Ketua ECB mempengaruhi kadar euro dan aliran modal global.
why.en: Who runs the ECB shapes euro rates and global capital flows.

summary.bm: Gardenia Malaysia Timur menjelaskan ia entiti berasingan daripada Gardenia KL selepas aduan membabitkan Original Classic White Bread dan Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. KKM menunggu keputusan makmal dan akan memeriksa kilang KL di bawah Akta Makanan 1983; nombor kelompok belum lengkap.
summary.en: Gardenia East Malaysia says it is separate from Gardenia KL after complaints involving Original Classic White Bread and Twiggies Choc-A-Lot. The Health Ministry awaits lab results and will inspect the KL factory under the Food Act 1983; batch numbers are incomplete.

title.bm: Malaysia: KKM siasat dakwaan sakit selepas makan produk Gardenia
title.en: Malaysia: KKM probes illness claims linked to Gardenia bread and snacks

why.bm: Nota keselamatan: simpan bungkusan dan lapor gejala kepada KKM; tiada penarikan balik diumumkan.
why.en: Safety note: keep the packaging and report symptoms to KKM; no recall announced.

summary.bm: Kiraan terkini CIDRAP ialah 10,444 kes dan 5,376 kematian (5,372 di DRC, masing-masing dua di Kenya dan Uganda), kadar kematian 51.6%, tertumpu di Ituri dan Kivu Utara. Penjejakan kontak masih terhad dan tiada vaksin atau rawatan diluluskan untuk strain Bundibugyo. Pada 4 Nov WHO menyokong dua lagi calon vaksin (ChAdOx1 Oxford dan mRNA-1469 Moderna) untuk ujian Tumaini di Ituri, menunggu kelulusan kebangsaan; keputusan dijangka awal 2027. Laman CIDRAP terkini menyatakan kes menghampiri 11,000, dan MSF berkata vaksin Ervebo mungkin memberi perlindungan silang terhadap Bundibugyo.
summary.en: CIDRAP's latest tally is 10,444 cases and 5,376 deaths (5,372 in DRC, two each in Kenya and Uganda), a fatality rate of 51.6%, centred on Ituri and North Kivu. Contact tracing remains limited and there is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. On Nov 4 WHO backed two more candidate vaccines (Oxford ChAdOx1 and Moderna mRNA-1469) for the Tumaini trial in Ituri, pending national approvals; trial results are expected in early 2027. CIDRAP's latest homepage says cases are nearing 11,000, and MSF says the Ervebo vaccine may offer cross-protection against Bundibugyo.

title.bm: Ebola (Bundibugyo) di DRC: 5,376 kematian dan 10,444 kes ketika wabak memasuki bulan ketujuh
title.en: Ebola (Bundibugyo) in DRC: 5,376 deaths and 10,444 cases as outbreak enters seventh month

why.bm: Risiko kepada Malaysia rendah, tetapi pelancong ke Afrika Tengah/Timur perlu ikut nasihat kesihatan, elak kontak dengan orang sakit dan lapor demam selepas pulang. WHO menasihatkan agar tiada sekatan perjalanan atau perdagangan.
why.en: Risk to Malaysia is low, but travellers to Central/East Africa should follow health advisories, avoid contact with sick people and report fever after return. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions.

summary.bm: Tajuk laman CIDRAP menyatakan jumlah AS melepasi 5,100 kes dan seorang bayi di Wisconsin meninggal, kematian campak AS ketiga minggu itu. Angka daripada tajuk dan belum disahkan dengan artikel.
summary.en: CIDRAP's homepage headlines say the US total passed 5,100 cases and that a Wisconsin baby died, the third US measles death that week. Figures are from headlines and not yet checked against the articles.

title.bm: Kes campak AS 2026 melebihi 5,100; seorang bayi di Wisconsin antara yang meninggal
title.en: US measles cases top 5,100 in 2026; a Wisconsin infant is among deaths

why.bm: Semak status vaksin MMR keluarga anda, terutama sebelum bepergian.
why.en: Check your family's MMR vaccination status, especially before travel.

summary.bm: Dua kes disahkan klade 1 dan dua lagi disyaki menunggu analisis; tiga pesakit berkata mereka tidak keluar dari daerah itu setahun lalu. Klade 1 mempunyai kadar kematian dilaporkan 1% hingga 10%, berbanding 1% hingga 4% bagi klade 2.
summary.en: Two cases are confirmed clade 1 and two are suspected pending analysis; three patients say they did not leave the county in the past year. Clade 1 has a reported fatality rate of 1% to 10%, versus 1% to 4% for clade 2.

title.bm: California siasat empat kes mpox klade 1 di Stanislaus County, tiga tanpa sejarah perjalanan
title.en: California investigates four clade 1 mpox cases in Stanislaus County, three with no travel

why.bm: Penularan tempatan menunjukkan jangkitan tidak dikesan; elak sentuhan rapat dengan orang berruam dan dapatkan rawatan awal jika bergejala.
why.en: Local spread suggests undetected transmission; avoid close contact with anyone with a rash and seek care early if symptoms appear.

summary.bm: ChAdOx1 Oxford/Serum Institute dan mRNA-1469 Moderna akan menyertai ujian Tumaini yang bermula 23 Okt di Bunia dengan vaksinasi cincin. WHO merekodkan lebih 10,500 kes dan 5,126 kematian setakat 1 Nov.
summary.en: Oxford/Serum Institute ChAdOx1 and Moderna mRNA-1469 will join the Tumaini trial, which began Oct 23 in Bunia with ring vaccination. WHO counted over 10,500 cases and 5,126 deaths as of Nov 1.

title.bm: WHO tambah dua calon vaksin khusus Bundibugyo ke ujian Ebola DRC
title.en: WHO adds two Bundibugyo-specific vaccine candidates to DRC Ebola trial

why.bm: Pelancong ke kawasan terjejas patut mengikut nasihat KKM dan WHO.
why.en: Travellers to affected areas should follow KKM and WHO advisories.

summary.bm: Trump memberitahu CNN pertempuran semula 'sangat tidak mungkin' tetapi bergantung pada Iran menandatangani 'perjanjian yang sangat kukuh', menahan serangan baharu buat masa ini dan mengekalkan sekatan laut Hormuz. Menteri luar Iran berkata lawatan pengantara dihentikan selepas pilihan raya pertengahan AS, dan TV negara Iran melaporkan serangan semalaman di pulau Qeshm. Brent $91.88 pada 0246 GMT, kira-kira 22% di bawah paras tertinggi $118 pada 30 Okt.
summary.en: Trump told CNN renewed fighting is "highly unlikely" but depends on Iran signing "a very strong agreement", said he will hold off new strikes for now and keep the Hormuz naval blockade. Iran's foreign minister said mediator travel paused after the US midterms, and Iranian state TV reported an overnight attack on Qeshm island. Brent was $91.88 by 0246 GMT, about 22% below the $118 high of Oct 30.

title.bm: Trump: perang Iran 'secara ketenteraan sudah berakhir' selepas bertemu PM Qatar, tetapi sekatan Hormuz kekal
title.en: Trump says Iran war is 'militarily effectively over' after meeting Qatar's PM, but Hormuz blockades remain

why.bm: Hormuz menentukan harga minyak dan kos perkapalan untuk Malaysia.
why.en: Hormuz decides oil prices and shipping costs for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Hari pertama rundingan Rusia-Ukraine anjuran AS di Abu Dhabi berlangsung kira-kira empat setengah jam; Zelensky menyifatkannya "membina dan agak substantif", walaupun CBS melaporkan tiada tanda kemajuan. Harapan meningkat untuk pertukaran tahanan besar-besaran dan rundingan lanjut dijangka minggu depan.
summary.en: The first day of US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi lasted around four and a half hours; Zelensky called it "constructive and quite substantive", though CBS reported no signs of progress. Hopes are rising for a large prisoner swap, and further talks are expected next week.

title.bm: Rundingan Abu Dhabi tamat pusingan pertama selepas kira-kira 4.5 jam; rundingan lanjut dijangka minggu depan
title.en: Abu Dhabi talks end first round after about 4.5 hours; more talks expected next week

why.bm: Perjanjian akan meredakan tekanan harga tenaga dan bijirin; kegagalan mengekalkan perbelanjaan keselamatan Eropah dan sekatan.
why.en: A deal would ease pressure on energy and grain prices; failure keeps European security spending and sanctions in play.

summary.bm: Al Jazeera melaporkan pertahanan udara Saudi memintas peluru berpandu ke arah Riyadh pada 10 Nov selepas serangan Houthi ke atas saluran paip, manakala tentera kerajaan Yaman mendakwa kemaraan baharu apabila serangan sempadan Houthi bermula semula. PBB berkata lebih 1,600 terbunuh dan 300,000 berpindah sejak gencatan 2022 runtuh pada Julai.
summary.en: Al Jazeera reports Saudi air defences downed missiles fired at Riyadh on Nov 10 after a Houthi attack on a pipeline, while Yemeni government forces claim new advances as Houthi border attacks resume. The UN says over 1,600 have been killed and 300,000 displaced since the 2022 truce collapsed in July.

title.bm: Arab Saudi memintas peluru berpandu ke arah Riyadh selepas serangan Houthi ke atas saluran paip
title.en: Saudi Arabia downs missiles fired at Riyadh after Houthi attack on a pipeline

why.bm: Meluaskan konflik Teluk dan mengancam infrastruktur minyak.
why.en: Widens the Gulf conflict and threatens oil infrastructure.

summary.bm: Menurut Israel Hayom yang memetik diplomat tanpa nama, cadangan Qatar akan membuka semula Hormuz dan menamatkan sekatan AS sebagai ganti penghentian serangan ke atas kapal Teluk, dengan AS$8 bilion dana Iran dilepaskan. Beberapa pegawai kanan AS dilaporkan menentang dan Trump dikatakan ragu-ragu; belum disahkan secara rasmi.
summary.en: Per Israel Hayom citing unnamed diplomats, a Qatari proposal would reopen Hormuz and lift the US blockade in return for an end to attacks on Gulf shipping, with $8bn of Iranian funds unfrozen. Several senior US officials reportedly oppose it and Trump is said to be sceptical; unconfirmed officially.

title.bm: Trump bertemu PM Qatar, tetapi tiada perjanjian segera dijangka bagi menamatkan perang Iran; pelan Hormuz dilaporkan lepaskan AS$8 bilion
title.en: Trump to meet Qatar's PM, but no imminent deal seen to end the Iran war; reported Hormuz plan would unfreeze $8bn

why.bm: Perjanjian akan meredakan tekanan harga minyak dan bahan api; kegagalan berisiko serangan semula.
why.en: A deal would ease oil and fuel-price pressure; failure risks renewed attacks.

summary.bm: CENTCOM mengumumkan "Task Force Iron Gate" pada Sabtu untuk melanjutkan sekatan laut ke laluan perdagangan darat termasuk Caspian; Trump kata ia berkuat kuasa penuh. Rubio berkata kedua-dua pihak belum hampir kepada terobosan, dan Trump memberitahu 60 Minutes tiada sebab untuk meningkatkan konflik.
summary.en: CENTCOM announced "Task Force Iron Gate" on Saturday to extend the naval blockade to overland trade routes including the Caspian; Trump says it is in full force. Rubio said the sides are not on the verge of a breakthrough, and Trump told 60 Minutes he sees no reason to escalate.

title.bm: AS lanjutkan sekatan Iran ke laluan darat ketika Rubio kata terobosan belum hampir
title.en: US extends Iran blockade to overland routes as Rubio says no breakthrough is near

why.bm: Tekanan lebih ketat ke atas Iran mengekalkan turun naik harga minyak dan bahan api.
why.en: Tighter pressure on Iran keeps oil and fuel prices volatile.

summary.bm: Times of Israel melaporkan Eisenkot diberi mandat membentuk kerajaan dan berkata tugas itu memerlukan langkah kreatif dan luar biasa. Penunjuk perasaan di Tel Aviv juga berhimpun pada 7 Nov berhubung siasatan Shin Bet terhadap pilihan raya.
summary.en: Times of Israel reports Eisenkot has been given the mandate to form a government, saying the task needs creative, unconventional moves. Tel Aviv protesters also rallied on Nov 7 over a Shin Bet election probe.

title.bm: Eisenkot diberi mandat membentuk kerajaan Israel
title.en: Eisenkot gets mandate to form Israel's next government

why.bm: Hasil gabungan mempengaruhi dasar Gaza dan Iran.
why.en: The coalition outcome shapes Gaza and Iran policy.

summary.bm: Liputan langsung Fox News melaporkan arahan AS mengganggu laluan pengangkutan darat Iran, memperluas sekatan laut. Houthi mendakwa serangan udara Saudi membunuh puluhan orang; dakwaan itu belum disahkan secara bebas.
summary.en: Fox News live coverage reports a US order to disrupt Iranian ground-transport routes, widening the naval blockade. The Houthis say Saudi air strikes killed dozens; the claim is not independently verified.

title.bm: Trump arah sekatan pengangkutan darat Iran ketika Houthi dakwa serangan udara Saudi membunuh puluhan
title.en: Trump orders blockade on Iranian ground transport as Houthis claim Saudi air strikes killed dozens

why.bm: Eskalasi Teluk yang meluas mengekalkan risiko minyak dan perkapalan untuk Malaysia.
why.en: Wider Gulf escalation keeps oil and shipping risk high for Malaysia.

summary.bm: Menteri Luar Filipina Lazaro dan Wang Yi dari China berbual telefon dan kedua-duanya menyifatkannya membina, walaupun versi Beijing menuduh Manila 'campur tangan berniat jahat'. Filipina menjadi tuan rumah mesyuarat pemimpin pada 16-18 Nov, dan Rubio berkata sidang kemuncak pemimpin Quad pertama sejak 2024 akan diadakan di Manila serentak, memetik risiko Laut China Selatan dan Selat Taiwan. Perdana Menteri China Li Qiang dijangka hadir.
summary.en: Philippine Foreign Secretary Lazaro and China's Wang Yi spoke by phone and both called it constructive, though Beijing's account accused Manila of 'malicious interference'. The Philippines hosts leaders' meetings from Nov 16-18, and Rubio says the first Quad leaders' summit since 2024 will be held in Manila alongside it, citing South China Sea and Taiwan Strait risks. Chinese Premier Li Qiang is expected to attend.

title.bm: Manila dan Beijing berikrar kekalkan dialog tetapi berbalas kritikan menjelang sidang kemuncak ASEAN di Manila dan mesyuarat pemimpin Quad
title.en: Manila and Beijing pledge dialogue but trade barbs ahead of the Manila ASEAN summit and a Quad leaders' meeting

why.bm: Malaysia berada di tengah diplomasi Laut China Selatan ASEAN dan berdagang dengan kedua-dua kuasa.
why.en: Malaysia sits at the centre of ASEAN's South China Sea diplomacy and trade with both powers.

summary.bm: S-1 terkini Anthropic menawarkan 825 juta saham Kelas A pada $70–$78, menjana kira-kira $57.75 bilion–$64.35 bilion kasar dengan nilai tersirat sehingga $1.404 trilion (berbanding $965 bilion pada Mei). Dagangan di Nasdaq dijangka sekitar 19 Nov di bawah simbol ANT; penempatan persendirian $26 bilion berasingan ditawarkan kepada rakan cip dan awan termasuk Nvidia, Google dan Microsoft.
summary.en: Anthropic's updated S-1 offers 825 million Class A shares at $70–$78, raising roughly $57.75bn–$64.35bn gross and implying a valuation of up to $1.404tn (versus $965bn in May). Trading is expected on Nasdaq around Nov 19 under the ticker ANT; a separate $26bn private placement goes to chip and cloud partners including Nvidia, Google and Microsoft.

title.bm: Anthropic menetapkan julat harga IPO $70–$78 sesaham menjelang pendebutan di Nasdaq
title.en: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70–$78 a share ahead of Nasdaq debut

why.bm: Terma kini dalam pemfailan; salah satu penyenaraian teknologi terbesar dan petunjuk selera pasaran terhadap sektor AI.
why.en: Terms are now in the filing; one of the largest tech listings ever and a gauge of AI-sector appetite.

summary.bm: TechCrunch melaporkan Anthropic melancarkan dua model baharu, dengan kebimbangan peningkatan diri rekursif sebagai latar. Berasingan, ia dilaporkan membeli turbin gas bernilai $3.4 bilion untuk keperluan kuasa AI.
summary.en: TechCrunch reports Anthropic released two new models, framing the launch around concerns about recursive self-improvement. Separately it reportedly bought $3.4bn of gas turbines to power AI demand.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar model Mythos dan Fable baharu di tengah kebimbangan peningkatan diri rekursif
title.en: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid recursive self-improvement concerns

why.bm: Pelancaran model termaju mempengaruhi alat AI, perdebatan keselamatan dan IPO yang bakal tiba.
why.en: Frontier-model releases shape AI tools, safety debate and the coming IPO.

summary.bm: Platform ejen AI DeepSeek dilaporkan mencapai 1.54 juta pengguna aktif harian, menurut Bloomberg melalui satu ringkasan, selepas ia melancarkan "ejen super" untuk pengekodan. Ia meletakkan DeepSeek bersaing dengan OpenAI dan Anthropic dalam ejen AI.
summary.en: DeepSeek's AI agent platform has reportedly reached 1.54 million daily active users, per Bloomberg via a digest, after it unveiled its coding-focused "super agent". It positions DeepSeek against OpenAI and Anthropic in agents.

title.bm: DeepSeek melancarkan 'super agent' AI untuk pengekodan, mencabar OpenAI dan Anthropic
title.en: DeepSeek unveils an AI 'super agent' aimed at coding, challenging OpenAI and Anthropic

why.bm: Ejen pengekodan pesaing yang lebih murah boleh mengubah harga dan pilihan bagi pembangun dan pasukan IT.
why.en: Cheaper rival coding agents can shift pricing and choice for developers and IT teams.

summary.bm: E-mel Anthropic pada 7 Nov, seperti diringkaskan AI Weekly, menyatakan data terdedah ialah ID akaun/organisasi, tahap pelan, penggunaan dan perbelanjaan; kandungan perbualan, kata laluan dan data bayaran dilaporkan tidak terlibat. Belum disahkan dengan notis rasmi Anthropic.
summary.en: An Anthropic email of Nov 7, as summarised by AI Weekly, says exposed data was account/org IDs, plan tier, usage and spend; conversation content, passwords and payment data were reportedly not included. Not yet verified against Anthropic's own notice.

title.bm: Anthropic dilaporkan memaklumkan pelanggan perusahaan sebuah firma keselamatan pihak ketiga mengakses sistem dalaman
title.en: Anthropic reportedly tells enterprise customers a third-party security firm accessed internal systems

why.bm: Pentadbir perusahaan perlu membaca notis dan berwaspada terhadap pancingan data menggunakan butiran akaun.
why.en: Enterprise admins should read the notice and watch for phishing using account details.

summary.bm: VentureBeat dan TheNextWeb melaporkan model berfokus keselamatan ini dinilai 'Critical' dan berharga lebih tinggi daripada pesaing Anthropic dan Google. Laporan menyebut ia menemui 81 kelemahan Firefox berkeparahan tinggi dan membina 948 eksploit kernel Linux dalam ujian.
summary.en: VentureBeat and TheNextWeb report the security-focused model is rated 'Critical' and priced above Anthropic and Google rivals. Reports say it found 81 high-severity Firefox flaws and built 948 Linux kernel exploits in testing.

title.bm: OpenAI lancar GPT-6 Cyber, dilapor menemui 81 kelemahan Firefox berkeparahan tinggi
title.en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, which it says found 81 high-severity Firefox flaws

why.bm: AI yang mencari dan mengeksploitasi kelemahan sepantas ini memendekkan tempoh untuk menampal sistem.
why.en: AI that finds and exploits bugs this fast shortens the patching window for IT teams.

summary.bm: TechCrunch melaporkan pengumpulan dana tambahan itu menilai OpenAI pada AS$1.25 trilion; ia juga memetik data Ramp bahawa perbelanjaan AI menyusut ketika Anthropic menghampiri IPO.
summary.en: TechCrunch reports the extra raise values OpenAI at $1.25 trillion; separately it notes Ramp data showing AI spending stalling as Anthropic nears its IPO.

title.bm: OpenAI dilaporkan kutip tambahan AS$11 bilion pada penilaian AS$1.25 trilion
title.en: OpenAI reportedly raises another $11bn at a $1.25tn valuation

why.bm: Menunjukkan aliran modal besar ke AI termaju dan sentimen yang rapuh selepas kejatuhan saham AI.
why.en: Shows how much capital still flows into frontier AI, and how fragile sentiment is after the AI-stock rout.

summary.bm: Kelemahan CVSS 8.1 ini menjejaskan OpenSSH pada musl dengan PAM dimatikan, termasuk konfigurasi lalai Alpine, dan membolehkan penyerang log masuk akaun tanpa kata laluan sah. Ia dibaiki dalam OpenSSH 10.6p2; percubaan eksploit pertama berlaku kurang sembilan jam selepas penerbitan. CISA menambahnya ke katalog KEV pada 9 Nov bersama kelemahan GPUStack, FreeSWITCH dan IBM Aspera Faspex; tarikh akhir persekutuan ialah 12 Nov.
summary.en: The CVSS 8.1 flaw affects OpenSSH on musl with PAM disabled, including Alpine's default, and lets attackers log into accounts with no usable password. It is fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2; a first exploit attempt came under nine hours after publication. CISA added it to its KEV catalog on Nov 9 with GPUStack, FreeSWITCH and IBM Aspera Faspex flaws; federal deadline is Nov 12.

title.bm: Kelemahan OpenSSH 'SSHole' CVE-2026-123158 dieksploitasi dalam beberapa jam
title.en: OpenSSH 'SSHole' flaw CVE-2026-123158 exploited within hours of disclosure

why.bm: Tampal hos SSH Alpine/musl ke 10.6p2 atau aktifkan PAM.
why.en: Patch Alpine/musl SSH hosts to 10.6p2 or enable PAM.

summary.bm: Seorang penyelidik menerbitkan rantaian eksploit berdasarkan 33 kelemahan kritikal dalam N-central; tiga membawa kepada pelaksanaan kod jauh dan satu kepada akses root. N-able menutup perkhidmatan hosted dan menyuruh pelanggan on-premises berbuat demikian; tiada eksploitasi aktif dilihat dan hotfix sedang dibangunkan.
summary.en: A researcher published exploit chains built on 33 critical flaws in N-central; three lead to remote code execution and one to root. N-able took its hosted service offline and told on-premises customers to do the same; no active exploitation seen yet and a hotfix is in development.

title.bm: N-able menutup N-central selepas rantaian eksploit "Able2Shell" didedahkan
title.en: N-able takes N-central offline after "Able2Shell" exploit chains disclosed

why.bm: Jika anda menjalankan N-central on-premises, biarkan ia luar talian sehingga N-able mengesahkan hotfix, dan semak log masuk sejak 8 Nov.
why.en: If you run on-premises N-central, keep it offline until N-able confirms the hotfix, and review logins since Nov 8.

summary.bm: Penjana nombor rawak lemah akibat ralat binaan 2021 membolehkan penyerang membina semula seed; kecurian bermula 30 Julai. Firmware baharu tidak boleh membaiki seed terjejas, jadi pengguna mesti berpindah ke seed baharu.
summary.en: A weak random-number generator from a 2021 build error let attackers rebuild seeds; thefts began July 30. Updated firmware cannot fix affected seeds, so users must move to a new seed.

title.bm: Kelemahan dompet Coldcard di sebalik kecurian ~AS$116 juta cetus pertikaian semakan keselamatan
title.en: Coldcard wallet flaw behind ~US$116m theft sparks dispute over security reviews

why.bm: Pemilik Coldcard lama patut kemas kini firmware dan memindahkan dana ke seed baharu.
why.en: Owners of older Coldcards should update firmware and migrate funds to a new seed.

summary.bm: CISA menandakan CVE-2026-19868, pintasan pengesahan SAML SonicOS yang turut mengatasi MFA berkuatkuasa SAML, dengan kemungkinan eksploitasi; SonicWall telah menampalnya. Berasingan, SonicWall tidak akan membaiki kelemahan produk GMS.
summary.en: CISA flagged CVE-2026-19868, a SonicOS SAML authentication bypass that also defeats SAML-enforced MFA, with possible exploitation; SonicWall has patched it. Separately, SonicWall will not fix flaws in its GMS product.

title.bm: Kelemahan pintasan MFA/SAML SonicWall SonicOS CVE-2026-19868 ditambah ke senarai KEV CISA
title.en: SonicWall SonicOS MFA/SAML bypass CVE-2026-19868 added to CISA KEV

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian: kemas kini SonicOS segera, semak log masuk VPN/SAML dan rancang ganti GMS kerana tiada pembaikan.
why.en: Network teams: update SonicOS now, review VPN/SAML logins, and plan to replace GMS since it gets no fix.

summary.bm: Kelemahan use-after-free bertahap keterukan tinggi dalam komponen XML Chrome dibaiki dalam Chrome 157.0.8103.50/.51 untuk Windows dan Mac serta .50 untuk Linux, dan Google berkata eksploitnya wujud di dunia nyata. Pepijat dilaporkan tanpa nama pada 6 Nov; butiran serangan belum didedahkan dan CISA belum menyenaraikannya dalam KEV.
summary.en: The high-severity use-after-free in Chrome's XML component is fixed in Chrome 157.0.8103.50/.51 for Windows and Mac and .50 for Linux, and Google says an exploit exists in the wild. The bug was reported anonymously on Nov 6; no attack details are public and CISA had not yet listed it in KEV.

title.bm: Google menampal zero-day Chrome kelapan yang dieksploitasi pada 2026 (CVE-2026-125350)
title.en: Google patches eighth exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026 (CVE-2026-125350)

why.bm: Kemas kini Chrome (serta Edge/pelayar Chromium lain) ke versi terkini sekarang dan mulakan semula.
why.en: Update Chrome (and Edge/other Chromium browsers) to the latest version now and relaunch.

summary.bm: Fahmi berkata laman web Bank Rakyat yang diurus pihak ketiga dirosakkan dan diambil alih, dan bank menyekat pelayan itu. Beliau berkata tiada kecurian data dan perbankan dalam talian selamat, manakala NACSA mencatat insiden di beberapa institusi kewangan.
summary.en: Fahmi says a third-party-managed Bank Rakyat site was defaced and taken over, and the bank blocked the server. He says there was no data theft and online banking remains safe, while NACSA noted incidents at several financial institutions.

title.bm: Laman web pihak ketiga Bank Rakyat dirosakkan; pengguna dialihkan ke i-Rakyat
title.en: Bank Rakyat's third-party website defaced; users redirected to i-Rakyat

why.bm: Gunakan hanya laman rasmi i-Rakyat dan abaikan dakwaan tidak sahih.
why.en: Use only the official i-Rakyat site and ignore unverified claims.

summary.bm: iPad mini OLED dengan A20 Pro, iMac M6 dan MacBook Pro 14 inci M6 serta MacBook Pro 14 dan 16 inci OLED skrin sentuh dilancarkan 6 Nov. MacTech turut melaporkan hasil suku keempat Apple naik 12%.
summary.en: The iPad mini with OLED and A20 Pro, M6 iMac and M6 14-inch MacBook Pro plus OLED touchscreen 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros launched Nov 6. MacTech also reports Apple's fourth-quarter revenue rose 12%.

title.bm: Lima produk baharu Apple dijual; HomeView dan Apple TV 4K menyusul 13 Nov
title.en: Apple's five new products go on sale; HomeView and Apple TV 4K follow on Nov 13

why.bm: MacBook Pro skrin sentuh dihantar dalam dua hingga tiga minggu.
why.en: Touchscreen MacBook Pros ship in two to three weeks.

summary.bm: ProductNation melaporkan pra-pesanan dibuka di kedai Apple Malaysia, dengan ketersediaan dari 6 Nov. iPad mini OLED bermula RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, tambah RM700 untuk selular), dan MacBook Pro 14 inci M5 Pro skrin sentuh dengan 24GB dan 1TB bermula RM11,999.
summary.en: ProductNation reports pre-orders are open on Apple's Malaysian store, with availability from Nov 6. The OLED iPad mini starts at RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, RM700 more for cellular), and the touchscreen 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB and 1TB starts at RM11,999.

title.bm: Harga Malaysia ditetapkan: MacBook Pro skrin sentuh dari RM11,999, iPad mini dari RM2,999, dihantar 6 Nov
title.en: Malaysia prices set: touchscreen MacBook Pro from RM11,999, iPad mini from RM2,999, shipping Nov 6

why.bm: Ini menjawab persoalan harga Malaysia sebelum pelancaran Jumaat.
why.en: This answers the open Malaysian pricing question before Friday's launch.

summary.bm: Bermula iOS, iPadOS, macOS dan visionOS 27.3, fail dan foto yang dikongsi dengan 'sesiapa yang ada pautan' boleh diakses Apple untuk semakan, walaupun Advanced Data Protection dihidupkan. Pautan yang dikongsi hanya dengan individu tertentu dikecualikan, dan Apple boleh membuang kandungan atau melumpuhkan akaun, dengan keluaran awam dijangka pada Disember.
summary.en: From iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, files and photos shared with 'Anyone with the link' become accessible to Apple for review, even with Advanced Data Protection on. Links shared only with named people are excluded, and Apple may remove content or disable accounts, with public release expected in December.

title.bm: Apple akan semak pautan iCloud awam untuk kandungan berbahaya mulai iOS 27.3, menamatkan penyulitan hujung ke hujung bagi pautan itu
title.en: Apple will review public iCloud links for harmful content from iOS 27.3, ending end-to-end encryption for them

why.bm: Jika anda berkongsi pautan iCloud secara awam, anggap ia tidak peribadi; kongsi dengan individu tertentu sebaliknya.
why.en: If you share iCloud links publicly, treat them as non-private; share with named people instead.

summary.bm: Pembangun kini boleh menetapkan mesej pengekalan dalam App Store Connect yang muncul dalam aliran pembatalan, dengan teks, imej atau tawaran khas. API Retention Messaging yang berasingan, tersedia atas permintaan, membolehkan aplikasi memilih mesej bagi setiap pelanggan.
summary.en: Developers can now set retention messages in App Store Connect that appear in the cancellation flow, with text, images or a special offer. A separate Retention Messaging API, available by request, lets apps choose messages per subscriber.

title.bm: App Store benarkan pembangun papar tawaran pengekalan apabila pelanggan cuba membatalkan langganan
title.en: App Store lets developers show retention offers when subscribers try to cancel

why.bm: Jangkakan tawaran diskaun apabila anda membatalkan langganan aplikasi.
why.en: Expect discount offers when you cancel an app subscription.

summary.bm: Beberapa media melaporkan pemilik Pixel masih menunggu kemas kini November 2026. Android Authority mencadangkan Android 17 QPR2 mungkin sebabnya.
summary.en: Several outlets report Pixel owners are still waiting for the November 2026 update. Android Authority suggests Android 17 QPR2 may be the reason.

title.bm: Kemas kini Pixel November Google masih belum tiba; Android 17 QPR2 mungkin puncanya
title.en: Google's November Pixel update still missing; Android 17 QPR2 may explain delay

why.bm: Pengguna Pixel perlu pantau tampalan itu.
why.en: Pixel users should watch for the patch.

summary.bm: SecurityWeek berkata kemas kini November membaiki lebih 200 kelemahan; The Hacker News menyebut CVE-2026-58868, kelemahan kritikal yang membolehkan pelaksanaan kod jauh tanpa interaksi pengguna pada Android 14 hingga 17.
summary.en: SecurityWeek says the November updates fix over 200 vulnerabilities; The Hacker News notes CVE-2026-58868, a critical flaw allowing remote code execution without user interaction on Android 14 to 17.

title.bm: Kemas kini Android November tampal 200+ kelemahan, termasuk RCE kritikal CVE-2026-58868
title.en: Android November updates patch 200+ flaws, including critical RCE CVE-2026-58868

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini keselamatan Android terkini sebaik sahaja tersedia pada telefon anda.
why.en: Install the latest Android security update as soon as it reaches your phone.

summary.bm: Kumpulan Threat Intelligence Google dan polis Jepun mengganggu pelayan kawalan dan mengharamkan pembuat Videostrong daripada menghasilkan peranti Android bertauliah. Penutupan itu tidak membersihkan kotak yang dijangkiti, dan Google berkata ia mungkin memutuskan sekurang-kurangnya 10 juta lagi peranti yang terjejas. NACSA berkata malware XCPE ditanam dalam peranti semasa pembuatan.
summary.en: Google's Threat Intelligence Group and Japan's police disrupted the command servers and banned maker Videostrong from making certified Android devices. The takedown does not clean infected boxes, and Google says it may cut off at least 10 million more compromised devices. NACSA says the XCPE malware was planted in devices during manufacture.

title.bm: Google ganggu botnet XCPE yang menjangkiti lebih 1.3 juta kotak Android TV
title.en: Google disrupts XCPE botnet that infected over 1.3 million Android TV boxes

why.bm: Kotak Android TV murah tanpa jenama biasa di Malaysia; semak kotak anda dan pertimbangkan menggantinya jika terjejas.
why.en: Cheap unbranded Android TV boxes are common in Malaysia; check yours and consider replacing it if it is affected.

summary.bm: Diumumkan dalam Kemas Kini Sistem Google November, ia ruang khas untuk alat pengurusan keluarga. 9to5Google berkata pelancaran belum meluas.
summary.en: Announced in the November Google System Update, it is a dedicated space for family management tools. 9to5Google says the rollout had not started widely.

title.bm: Google sahkan 'Family Hub' Android dalam Tetapan
title.en: Google confirms Android 'Family Hub' in Settings

why.bm: Membantu ibu bapa mengurus akaun dan kebenaran keluarga.
why.en: Helps parents manage family accounts and permissions.

summary.bm: Perjanjian bersama itu memberi modal permulaan AS$1.85 bilion (SoftBank AS$1 bilion, Grab AS$750 juta, Petros AS$100 juta), menyasarkan 5 GW atau lebih di Sarawak dan Semenanjung secara berperingkat.
summary.en: The joint deals give seed capital of US$1.85bn (SoftBank US$1bn, Grab US$750m, Petros US$100m), targeting 5 GW or more across Sarawak and Peninsular Malaysia in stages.

title.bm: SoftBank, Grab dan Petros bina kemudahan AI besar di Malaysia dengan modal permulaan AS$1.85 bilion
title.en: SoftBank, Grab and Petros to build large AI facilities in Malaysia with US$1.85bn seed capital

why.bm: Menambah pembangunan pusat data Malaysia dan Pelan Tindakan AI Nasional 2026-2030.
why.en: Adds to Malaysia's data-centre build-out and the National AI Action Plan 2026-2030.

summary.bm: Malay Mail melaporkan rangkaian 5G kedua mencapai liputan 90% lebih awal.
summary.en: Malay Mail reports the second 5G network hit 90% coverage early.

title.bm: Rangkaian 5G kedua capai liputan 90% lebih awal, kata Fahmi
title.en: Second 5G network reaches 90% coverage ahead of schedule, says Fahmi

why.bm: 5G lebih luas untuk pengguna dan perniagaan.
why.en: Wider 5G for consumers and business.

summary.bm: Tesla berkata akan menamatkan pengeluaran Cybertruck pada 2027 dan menaikkan harga sehingga 10%, menurut Electrek.
summary.en: Tesla says it will end Cybertruck production in 2027 and raised prices by up to 10%, according to Electrek.

title.bm: Tesla akan hentikan pengeluaran Cybertruck pada 2027
title.en: Tesla to stop making the Cybertruck in 2027

why.bm: Petanda betapa sukarnya segmen EV premium.
why.en: A signal of how tough the premium EV segment has become.

summary.bm: Google berkata tambahan AS$15 bilion akan mengembangkan pusat datanya di Malaysia dalam dua tahun dan menjangka 37,000 pekerjaan. Anwar mengalu-alukan pelaburan itu.
summary.en: Google says the extra US$15 billion will expand its Malaysian data centre footprint over two years and projects 37,000 jobs. Anwar hailed the investment.

title.bm: Google tambah komitmen AS$15 bilion untuk pusat data Malaysia dalam tempoh dua tahun
title.en: Google commits another US$15bn to Malaysian data centres over two years

why.bm: Rangsangan besar kepada ekosistem pusat data dan awan serta pekerjaan teknologi di Malaysia.
why.en: A big boost for Malaysia's data-centre and cloud ecosystem and tech jobs.

summary.bm: Diumumkan di AWS Cloud and AI Day di Kuala Lumpur, ia merangkumi perintis GovHub untuk 500 pembangun meningkat kepada 4,000 menjelang 2028 dan Amazon Quick untuk 445,000 pegawai. PKS mendapat akses percuma Quick dan Kiro selama enam bulan selepas penilaian, selaras komitmen AWS sebanyak RM29.2 bilion di Malaysia.
summary.en: Announced at AWS Cloud and AI Day in Kuala Lumpur, it includes a GovHub pilot for 500 developers rising to 4,000 by 2028 and Amazon Quick for 445,000 officers. SMEs get six months of free Quick and Kiro access after an assessment, building on AWS's RM29.2 billion Malaysian commitment.

title.bm: AWS lancar Semarak AI Malaysia, tawar alat AI kepada 445,000 pegawai kerajaan dan 10,000 PKS menjelang 2028
title.en: AWS launches Semarak AI Malaysia, offering AI tools to 445,000 government officers and 10,000 SMEs by 2028

why.bm: Ia membawa alat AI percuma kepada PKS dan perkhidmatan awam Malaysia, bukan sekadar perbelanjaan pusat data.
why.en: It brings free AI tooling to Malaysian SMEs and the civil service, not just data-centre spending.

summary.bm: SpaceX memilih platform infrastruktur Dragonwing QRU100 dan QDU100 Qualcomm untuk Starlink Mobile, yang Qualcomm gelar perjanjian 5G terbesarnya, menurut Reuters. Kira-kira seminggu lebih awal T-Mobile dilaporkan berkata tiada ruang untuk perjanjian MVNO dengan SpaceX.
summary.en: SpaceX picked Qualcomm's Dragonwing QRU100 and QDU100 infrastructure platforms for Starlink Mobile, which Qualcomm called its biggest 5G deal yet, per Reuters. About a week earlier T-Mobile reportedly said there was no room for an MVNO deal with SpaceX.

title.bm: Qualcomm dan SpaceX bersetuju bina rangkaian 5G Starlink dengan sasaran debut AS pada 2027
title.en: Qualcomm and SpaceX agree to build a Starlink 5G network aimed at a 2027 US debut

why.bm: SpaceX sedang membina rangkaian mudah alihnya sendiri, yang akhirnya boleh mencabar syarikat telekom.
why.en: SpaceX is building its own mobile network, which could eventually challenge telcos.

summary.bm: Loke meletak jawatan serta-merta pada 10 Nov selepas perintah Mahkamah Tinggi, dan menggesa pengundi Melaka menzahirkan pendirian mengenai Najib pada 14 Nov. Beliau menyifatkan gesaan bubar Parlimen sebagai 'permainan politik' dan DAP kekal menyokong Anwar; rombakan kecil jawatan DAP dijangka.
summary.en: Loke resigned with immediate effect on Nov 10 after the High Court order, and urged Melaka voters to express their view on Najib at the Nov 14 ballot. He called calls to dissolve Parliament 'political play' and said DAP still backs Anwar; a minor Cabinet reshuffle of DAP posts is expected.

title.bm: Anthony Loke letak jawatan Menteri Pengangkutan selepas Mahkamah Tinggi benarkan Najib jalani tahanan rumah
title.en: DAP's Anthony Loke quits as transport minister after High Court lets Najib serve house arrest

why.bm: Ia meningkatkan ketegangan gabungan beberapa hari sebelum PRN Melaka dan menjelang PRU16.
why.en: It raises coalition tension days before the Melaka poll and ahead of GE16.

summary.bm: CVE-2026-124194 ialah kelemahan spoofing Outlook (CVSS 6.5) yang dilaporkan dieksploitasi sebelum tampalan; CISA menambahkannya ke KEV pada 10 Nov dengan tarikh akhir persekutuan 24 Nov. Microsoft belum mendedahkan penyerang atau sasaran.
summary.en: CVE-2026-124194 is an Outlook spoofing flaw (CVSS 6.5) reported as exploited before the fix; CISA added it to KEV on Nov 10 with a Nov 24 federal deadline. Microsoft has not shared attribution or targets.

title.bm: Patch Tuesday November Microsoft menampal zero-day Outlook yang dieksploitasi (CVE-2026-124194)
title.en: Microsoft November Patch Tuesday fixes an exploited Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194)

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini Office/Outlook November pada semua mesin.
why.en: Install the November Office/Outlook updates on all machines.

summary.bm: Senarai termasuk pintasan pengesahan Barracuda Email Security Gateway CVE-2026-116606 (CVSS 9.3, dibaiki dalam 9.4.0.030, tarikh akhir 13 Nov) dan XXE Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 (dibaiki dalam RI.2026.07). Chrome CVE-2026-125350 dibaiki dalam 157.0.8103.50.
summary.en: The list includes Barracuda Email Security Gateway auth bypass CVE-2026-116606 (CVSS 9.3, fixed in 9.4.0.030, due Nov 13) and Cisco BroadWorks XXE CVE-2026-20320 (fixed in RI.2026.07). Chrome CVE-2026-125350 is fixed in 157.0.8103.50.

title.bm: CISA tambah enam kelemahan dieksploitasi ke KEV: Barracuda, Chrome, Outlook dan Cisco BroadWorks
title.en: CISA adds six exploited flaws to KEV: Barracuda, Chrome, Outlook and Cisco BroadWorks

why.bm: Pentadbir rangkaian: semak perkakas Barracuda dan versi BroadWorks sekarang.
why.en: Network admins: check Barracuda appliances and BroadWorks versions now.

summary.bm: Suite beta ini menyasarkan pekerja pengetahuan bukan pengaturcara, dengan Meetings (Team/Enterprise, bermula Google Meet), Whiteboards dan Sheets, serta Claude Data untuk pelan berbayar; penyambung kini meliputi 9,000+ aplikasi. Fortune melaporkan saham Microsoft jatuh lebih 2% dan roadshow IPO bermula hari sama.
summary.en: The beta suite targets non-coding knowledge workers, with Meetings (Team/Enterprise, Google Meet first), Whiteboards and Sheets, and Claude Data on paid plans; connectors now cover 9,000+ apps. Fortune says Microsoft shares fell over 2% and the IPO roadshow began the same day.

title.bm: Anthropic lancar Claude Meetings, Whiteboards, Sheets dan Data sebagai suite pejabat sebelum IPO
title.en: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings, Whiteboards, Sheets and Data as an office suite before its IPO

why.bm: Ia menolak Claude ke wilayah pejabat Microsoft dan Google.
why.en: It pushes Claude into Microsoft and Google's office territory.

summary.bm: Jenama disahkan boleh menuntut profil ChatGPT, memuat naik suapan produk dan menawarkan ejen perniagaan dalam sembang berlabel, secara beta untuk e-dagang dan perkhidmatan dalam talian AS yang layak. Peniaga Shopify boleh menyambung kedai.
summary.en: Verified brands can claim a ChatGPT profile, upload product feeds and offer a business agent in a labelled chat, in beta for eligible US ecommerce and online services. Shopify merchants can connect stores.

title.bm: OpenAI tambah profil perniagaan dan ejen dalam ChatGPT untuk e-dagang AS
title.en: OpenAI adds business profiles and agents to ChatGPT for US ecommerce

why.bm: Menunjukkan ChatGPT bergerak ke membeli-belah dan iklan.
why.en: Shows ChatGPT moving into shopping and ads.

summary.bm: Gemini 4 Carbon tiba kepada pelanggan AI Ultra dengan harga API pengenalan $2/$10 setiap sejuta token hingga 30 Nov. Google juga menerbitkan dua TPU generasi kelapan baharu pada 9 Nov.
summary.en: Gemini 4 Carbon reached AI Ultra subscribers with introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens through Nov 30. Google also published two new eighth-generation TPUs on Nov 9.

title.bm: Google lancar Gemini 4 Carbon untuk AI Ultra dan perkenal TPU 8tx serta 8i Max
title.en: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon to AI Ultra and unveils TPU 8tx and 8i Max

why.bm: Akses model terkini lebih murah dan persaingan cip AI meningkat.
why.en: Cheaper frontier access and more AI chip competition.

summary.bm: S&P 500 jatuh 0.38% kepada 7,520.93 dan Nasdaq 0.74% apabila CPI Oktober naik 0.4% berbanding jangkaan 0.3%. Hasil 2 tahun naik ke 4.736% dan Logan dari Fed mahu sekurang-kurangnya dua lagi kenaikan.
summary.en: The S&P 500 fell 0.38% to 7,520.93 and Nasdaq 0.74% as October CPI rose 0.4% versus 0.3% expected. The 2-year yield rose to 4.736% and Fed's Logan wants at least two more hikes.

title.bm: Wall Street ditutup rendah apabila kenaikan kadar Fed Disember sepenuhnya dijangka selepas CPI panas
title.en: Wall Street closes lower as a December Fed hike is fully priced after hot CPI

why.bm: Kadar AS lebih tinggi boleh menekan ringgit dan Bursa.
why.en: Higher US rates can pressure the ringgit and Bursa.

summary.bm: Rubio memberitahu sekutu G7 pada 10 Nov bahawa sekatan dan blokad menjadikan pertempuran besar tidak perlu, manakala Tehran menafikan rundingan dirancang. Minyak turun ke paras terendah dua bulan apabila pegawai AS merendahkan kemungkinan tindakan segera.
summary.en: Rubio told G7 allies on Nov 10 that sanctions and the blockade make major combat unnecessary, while Tehran denies planned talks. Oil eased to two-month lows as US officials downplayed imminent action.

title.bm: Rubio: sekatan dan blokad laut bermakna pertempuran besar terhadap Iran tidak perlu
title.en: Rubio says sanctions and naval blockade mean major combat against Iran is not needed

why.bm: Risiko eskalasi lebih rendah membantu harga bahan api, tetapi Hormuz kekal tertutup.
why.en: Lower escalation risk helps fuel prices, but Hormuz stays shut.

summary.bm: FMT melaporkan rombakan kecil dijangka selepas peletakan jawatan Loke, manakala Puad berkata Zahid bimbang kehilangan jawatan menteri. Mat Sabu turut menyeru tahanan rumah dibuka kepada semua banduan.
summary.en: FMT reports a minor reshuffle is expected after Loke's resignation, while Puad says Zahid is wary of losing his ministerial post. Mat Sabu also called for house arrest to be made available to all convicts.

title.bm: Rombakan kecil Kabinet jawatan DAP dijangka selepas Loke keluar
title.en: Minor Cabinet reshuffle of DAP posts expected after Loke's exit

why.bm: Menunjukkan bagaimana keputusan Najib membentuk semula kerajaan.
why.en: Shows how the Najib ruling is reshaping the government.

summary.bm: Mahkamah Tinggi mengawardkan ganti rugi RM30,000 kepada seorang budak yang patah kaki semasa kelas agama.
summary.en: The High Court awarded RM30,000 in damages to a boy who suffered a broken leg during a religious class.

title.bm: Mahkamah Tinggi award RM30,000 kepada budak patah kaki dalam kelas agama
title.en: High Court awards boy RM30,000 over broken leg in religious class

why.bm: Menjelaskan tanggungjawab penjagaan dalam kelas agama.
why.en: Clarifies the duty of care in religious classes.

title.en: Barracuda KEV patch deadline (CVE-2026-116606, CVE-2026-111560)

note.bm: Ujian penting BN dan PH menjelang PRU16.
note.en: Key test for BN and PH ahead of GE16.
